title: Investigate, independently verify, approve, publish exactly once
request: Build THREE agents. 'verifier' checks a claim of the form '<a>+<b>=<c>' with integers and answers CONFIRMED if a+b equals c, otherwise REJECTED. 'publisher' publishes findings PER USER (the entry agent tells it which user): it numbers that user's posts P-1, P-2, ... and publishing a finding it already published returns the existing post number instead of creating a new post. 'investigator' is the entry agent: for 'check <claim>' it asks verifier; if CONFIRMED it replies 'Confirmed F-<n>: <claim>' (that user's confirmed findings are numbered F-1, F-2, ...) with a review card titled 'Publish F-<n>?' whose Approve button has selection {"action":"publish","finding":"F-<n>"} and whose Reject button has selection {"action":"discard","finding":"F-<n>"}; if REJECTED it replies 'Not reproduced: <claim>' with no card. On publish it asks publisher and replies 'Published F-<n> as P-<m>' (a repeated publish of the same finding gives the same P-<m>); for a finding the user does not have it replies 'Unknown finding F-<n>'. On discard it replies 'Discarded F-<n>'.
